CONTRACT CLAUSE — ACME Corp / WidgetCo Supply Agreement (Exhibit A)

Dated: 2024-01-15

Section 4.2 — Delivery Schedule:
"WidgetCo shall deliver 10,000 units of Model-X widgets by March 31, 2024.
Failure to deliver within 14 days of this deadline constitutes a material breach."

Section 7.1 — Payment Terms:
"ACME Corp shall remit full payment of USD 250,000 within 30 days of confirmed delivery."

Section 9.3 — Force Majeure:
"Neither party shall be liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond their
reasonable control, including natural disasters, acts of government, or supply
chain disruptions certified by an independent auditor."
